name: week
title: This week in the union office
subtitle: Deadlines, dues and organising, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Statutory deadlines and rule checks
sections.note: Each row cites its rule. Sources in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule, record, detail, due_on, days_left, source from compliance_findings order by days_left nulls last, rule

sections.title: Overdue next steps on cases
sections.sql: select code, member, kind, organiser, next_step, next_step_due from case_load where overdue order by next_step_due

sections.title: Planned site visits
sections.sql: select code, workplace, organiser, visit_on, notice_given_on, permit_no, issue from visit_checks order by visit_on

name: dues
title: Dues and remittances
subtitle: Who has stopped paying and which employers are short

sections.title: Latest remittance from each employer
sections.sql: select employer_name as employer, remittance, period_start, period_end, received_on, payroll_members, members_on_file, expected_cents, received_cents, difference_cents, days_since_period from remittance_check order by difference_cents, employer

sections.title: Missing from the latest remittance
sections.sql: select employer, remittance, member_no, name, workplace from remittance_gaps order by employer, name

sections.title: Members in arrears
sections.note: Active members with no dues in six weeks.
sections.sql: select member_no, name, workplace, dues_method, last_paid_on, days_unpaid, owed_estimate_cents from arrears order by days_unpaid desc

sections.title: Density by workplace
sections.sql: select workplace, name, organiser, headcount, members, density_pct, delegates, hsrs from density order by density_pct nulls first

sections.title: Delegate roster issues
sections.sql: select name, workplace, role, elected_on, term_ends_on, trained_on, issue from delegate_roster where issue <> 'ok' order by workplace

sections.title: Agreements and bargaining
sections.sql: select code, name, jurisdiction, expires_on, days_to_expiry, window_opens_on, round, round_status, next_meeting_on, members_covered from bargaining_status order by expires_on

sections.title: Members at bargaining sites we have not spoken to in 90 days
sections.sql: select member_no, name, workplace, last_contact_on, days_quiet from quiet_members order by days_quiet desc nulls first
